title: Search engines can find a published Space website as its own site, with its own robots, sitemap and canonical URLs, instead of a noindexed copy that serves Frequency's crawler files

source.ref: PROG-E10 phase 4 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708); lift report /mnt/project-files/white-label/2026-10-06-lift-report.md

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 as phase 4 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708). THE CONSEQUENCE: a published site was noindex on every page and had no canonical, and on its own domain it served Frequency's robots.txt and sitemap.xml, because proxy.ts's matcher skips both files on every host (HYG-048), so danieltyack.com would have described Frequency to a crawler. THE FIX: the matcher gains a second arm that runs the proxy for /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml only on hosts that are NOT Frequency's own (missing: host matching APP_HOST_PATTERN, held equal to lib/sites/host.ts by host.test.ts), and routeSiteHost rewrites them to app/hosted/[host]/robots.txt and sitemap.xml route handlers that describe the site (Allow plus its own Sitemap line once published; Disallow all and a 404 sitemap otherwise). On Frequency's hosts the files still skip the proxy, and app/robots.ts and app/sitemap.ts are untouched, so the root metadata fan-out the deploy gates guard does not move and both stay statically cached. siteMetadata (components/sites/site-page.tsx) drops noindex for a published page and sets its canonical on the Space's bound domain (boundSiteDomain: spaces.domain resolved back to this Space through getSpaceByDomain, so the custom_domain gate applies) or else /sites/<slug>, with the brand title, the tagline as description, the cover or logo as share image and the logo as favicon. Unpublished, Private and unknown pages stay noindex or 404. The /spaces/<slug> profile root and its custom pages point their canonical at the site twin on the domain when the site is published there. Pure URL, robots and sitemap builders live in lib/sites/seo.ts with unit tests. OWNER STEP (optional): add the domain to Google Search Console and submit https://<domain>/sitemap.xml.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const proxy=r('proxy.ts');const host=r('lib/sites/host.ts');const page=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx');const prof=r('lib/spaces/profile-metadata.ts');const robots=r('app/hosted/[host]/robots.txt/route.ts');const sm=r('app/hosted/[host]/sitemap.xml/route.ts');const cfg=proxy.slice(proxy.indexOf('export const config'));const miss=[];if(!/missing:\s*\[\{\s*type:\s*'host'/.test(cfg)||!/source:\s*'\/\(robots[^']*sitemap/.test(cfg)||!/SITE_CRAWLER_FILES\.has\(pathname\)\)\s*return\s*\{\s*kind:\s*'rewrite'/.test(host))miss.push('a custom domain still serves Frequency robots.txt and sitemap.xml');if(!/siteRobotsTxt\(/.test(robots)||!/siteSitemapXml\(/.test(sm))miss.push('there is no site robots.txt or sitemap.xml route');const a=page.indexOf('export async function siteMetadata');const meta=a<0?'':page.slice(a,page.indexOf('export async function SitePage'));if(!/alternates:\s*\{\s*canonical/.test(meta)||!/index:\s*true/.test(meta)||!/boundSiteDomain\(/.test(meta))miss.push('a published site is still noindex or has no canonical on its domain');if(!/icons:/.test(meta)||!/images/.test(meta))miss.push('the site wears no brand favicon or share image');if(!/boundSiteDomain\(/.test(prof))miss.push('the Space profile does not point its canonical at the site domain');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-783: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Measures the consequence at each seam: a site host's crawler files reach the proxy and rewrite to the site's own robots and sitemap routes, those routes build the site's files, a published site page is indexable with a canonical computed from its bound domain plus a brand favicon and share image, and the profile canonical follows the domain. Failed on main before this change (the matcher had no host arm, siteMetadata was noindex with no canonical).
